# Apple Maps

2 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 2 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/apple_maps/places - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Apple Maps places by their Apple Maps ids, up to 50 in one call and 1 credit, one item per place in the order sent: name, Apple Maps link, category and categories, rating with its scale and rater (Apple rates 0 to 100 in place.rating.max 100, with Food & Drink, Atmosphere and Customer Service sub-ratings in place.ext.category_ratings; otherwise a partner such as Yelp rates out of 5; place.ext.rating_source says which), review count, price level, address with city, region, postal code and country, phone, coordinates, whether the business has claimed the listing (place.verified), description, photos, opening hours by weekday, amenities, website, and menu and ordering links. An id Apple Maps does not know is left out and named in data._warnings; every other place still comes back (a batch with unknown ids is looked up in parts, and any id not reached in time is listed there too). A lookup where no id is known returns an empty list and is not billed. GET /v1/apple_maps/search returns ids in place.id.

**Use when** you want to refresh places you already found, compare their ratings and hours, or enrich a list of Apple Maps ids in bulk.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** single page - Every place asked for comes back in one call (up to 50 ids); there is no next page.

**Query params**

- `ids` (required) - One to 50 Apple Maps place ids, comma-separated, for example 5144915183449522016. GET /v1/apple_maps/search returns them in place.id. · e.g. `5144915183449522016,4568414994170597789`
- `language` (optional, string) - Language and regional formatting as a locale, for example en-US, fr-FR or ja-JP (default en-US).

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.categories` | Additional categories beyond the primary one. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |

+28 more (types in the full schema): `place` {description, image_urls, latitude, longitude, phone, price_level, reviews_count, verified}; `place.ext` {address_parts, amenities, category_ids, city, country_code, guides, menu_url, order_url, photos, postal_code, rating_source} (+9 more). Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_maps/places" \
  --data-urlencode "ids=5144915183449522016,4568414994170597789" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/apple_maps/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns about 20 Apple Maps places for a query inside a map box (bbox, west,north,east,south as on GET /v1/yelp/search) or around a point (lat with lng), one item per place: the Apple Maps id in place.id (GET /v1/apple_maps/places takes it), name, Apple Maps link, category, Yelp's rating out of 5 and review count (place.ext.rating_source), up to three review snippets (place.ext.review_snippets), the Yelp id (place.ext.yelp_id, which the yelp endpoints take), price level, address, city, country, phone, coordinates, photos, opening hours by weekday, whether it is open now, and website. strict_bbox=false also lets in places just outside the box (default true). One call covers one box; search smaller boxes side by side to cover a city. Around a point the source looks at a much smaller area (one place in a test where the box around it gave 20), so prefer a box. A search can take up to 30 seconds.

**Use when** you want to find businesses in an area, tile a city box by box, or get Apple Maps and Yelp ids for the same place.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** single page - One call answers the whole map box (about 20 places); to cover more ground, search smaller boxes side by side.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - What to look for, for example coffee or a business name (up to 500 characters). · e.g. `coffee`
- `bbox` (optional, string) - The map box to search, as four decimal degrees west,north,east,south, for example -74.000,40.765,-73.970,40.745. Send bbox, or lat with lng. · e.g. `-74.000,40.765,-73.970,40.745`
- `lat` (optional, string) - Latitude of the point to search around, sent with lng when there is no bbox. A point covers a much smaller area than a box.
- `lng` (optional, string) - Longitude of the point to search around, sent with lat when there is no bbox.
- `strict_bbox` (optional, enum: true | false) - true (default) keeps only places inside the box; false also lets in places just outside it.

**Constraints**

- `lat` is a no-op without `lng` - sending it alone is a free 400.
- `lng` is a no-op without `lat` - sending it alone is a free 400.

**Response** `PlaceList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ place }` ([full schema](schemas/PlaceList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `place.id` | Place ID… |
| `place.name` | Business / hotel name |
| `place.url` | Website or canonical URL |
| `place.address` | Street address as the source prints it. |
| `place.category` | Primary category… |
| `place.image_urls` | Image URL, or a list of image URLs, for the place. |

+17 more (types in the full schema): `place` {latitude, longitude, phone, price_level, reviews_count}; `place.ext` {city, country_code, rank, rating_source, review_snippets, status, timezone, website, weekly_hours, yelp_id}; `place.rating` {max, value}. Never filled: `place.description`, `place.verified`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/apple_maps/search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=coffee" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
